outline:
數位化的空間設計和社會、文化理論和機能間的探討和應用。	This course investigates the concept of digital architecture in and through space and culture in the current information and communication technologies architecture and urban contexts. Do the spaces formed by practice-social activity, landscapes, monuments or buildings have meaning, how they were produced, and by whom? To answer to these questions various aspects of space and the element of culture in digital technologies will be examined. Issues of architectural and urban practices, and symbolism, and issues of re-presentations and re-producing and architectural forms will be examined in relation to the space and culture.
The primary requirement of the course is class participation. Students will write selected reaction papers and prepare weekly readings to help colleagues fully participate in discussion. The mainly evaluation will be the basis of their three selected reaction papers and conference draft and final paper.
